disconfirming_questions: Does Claude install.sh already calling the shared bootstrap mean Cursor sessionStart is done? No — live hook still inlines uv/scratch_hold and never calls the script.
Would adding another bootstrap_*.sh finish the architecture? No — that violates do-not-create-another-layer.
Can pec status/next replace preflight? No — they require a bootstrapped workspace and do not emit exact next command+args before admission.
Is draft-contract REPLACE_WITH an intentional operator prompt rather than a defect? The contract forbids reporting success for a consumer-rejected artifact.
Will sessionStart timeout (60s) break if the full shared bootstrap runs foreground? Probe: --quiet path; keep Cursor Graphiti hydrate in the hook; do not re-download gitleaks every session.
assumed_false_ifs: If shared bootstrap is treated as Cursor-complete because the file exists
If pec next is treated as preflight
If unit tests of pec internals are treated as runtime wiring proof
stress_test.blast_radius: Cursor sessionStart, Graphiti mutation gates, and PE controller CLI. A bad session-id unify can deny all governed writes or falsely allow them. A bad receipt fail-closed can block all PE. Makefile/root files are out of this remaining scope.
stress_test.rollback: Revert the new feature branch from origin/main. Shared bootstrap and capability plane on main stay. Hook self-heal recopies session_start_bootstrap.sh from SSOT on next session.
